description: Truncated + hallucinated list case (finding 1 from #625 adversarial review). Pre-Option-C v2.0 initial impl counted item-level rejected/missing rows as weight 1 while matched-item leaf rows counted as weight 1 each — so a 5-item list truncated to 2 (3 dropped, 2 leaves per item) reported tp=4, fn=3 → recall=0.571 instead of the leaf-normalized truth tp=4, fn=6, recall=0.40. Same shape with 2 GT items and 5 predicted (3 hallucinated) inflated precision from 0.40 → 0.571. Truncation is the flagship failure mode for bank-statement / agentic-table configs, so this fixture guards against a revert to unit-mixed counting. Post-fix: leaf-normalized counts throughout.

Transactions.description: 5-item list, model returns only 2 (3 truncated, 2 leaves per item)
